title: Fennel Apple Salad
headnote: A bright, crunchy fennel and Honeycrisp apple salad with lime, fresh chilies, cilantro, and olive oil. Adapted as a standalone side from the salad served with Vivek Surti’s spiced roast pork.

items: 1 fennel bulb, cored and very thinly sliced; fronds reserved
1 Honeycrisp apple (or another crisp, not-too-sour apple), very thinly sliced
2 serrano or red Thai chilies, thinly sliced into rounds
2 Tbsp cilantro, finely chopped (source document quantity)

steps: Prepare the fennel: remove the tough core and slice the bulb very thinly. Reserve the tender fronds.
Slice the apple very thinly. Zest and juice the limes; finely chop the cilantro and slice the chilies into thin rounds.
In a large bowl, combine the fennel bulb and fronds with the apple, lime zest and juice, sliced chilies, and cilantro. Toss together and season with kosher salt.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salad and toss again until lightly coated. Serve promptly as a fresh, crunchy side.
reviewFlags: The original Google Doc calls for 2 Tbsp cilantro, whereas the Bon Appétit source uses a small handful; the Google Doc quantity was preserved.
The Bon Appétit yield of 8 servings applies to the combined pork-and-salad meal, not necessarily to the salad alone; standalone yield has not been specified.
sourceNote: Standalone fennel and apple salad adapted from Vivek Surti, “Spiced Roast Pork With Fennel and Apple Salad,” Bon Appétit (September 17, 2019): https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/spiced-roast-pork-with-fennel-and-apple-salad.
